# Version 4.156.1 (Unreleased)
> **GPU rendering correctness**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.1 collects m156 fixes for transformed geometry, clipping, displacement filters and native Vulkan synchronization. The collected servicing changes keep managed APIs and dependency versions unchanged. Ganesh avoids stale atlas work after empty flushes, while Graphite respects render-pass clip capacity.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct transformed shapes and displacement sampling** — Ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke widths and corner radii map to the correct device-space axes; radii are clamped to prevent overlap. Displacement offset arithmetic now matches the float precision used to calculate filter bounds. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687), [#5711](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5711))
- **Keep atlas and clip work within the current flush** — Ganesh advances draw tokens after empty flushes to avoid stale atlas work. Graphite counts clips still needing recording and warns and skips a draw if its full clip stack cannot fit a fresh render pass. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
- **Respect failed synchronous Vulkan waits** — Native Ganesh submission now requires both queue submission and its requested fence wait to succeed. Asynchronous submission is unchanged; managed GRContext.Submit still returns void and does not expose a new failure result or exception. ([#5711](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5711))
